cards.answer: Milio is a support mage who protects allies with healing, shields and increased attack range. He adds magic damage to allies' attacks and ability hits, with AP scaling on his burn and shields.
cards.counterplay: Respect his allies' extended reach and look for pressure when his protective abilities are unavailable.

citations.quote: Name: Milio. Official role tags: Support, Mage.
Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside.
Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed.

facts.claim: protects allies with healing, shields and increased attack range

citations.quote: Milio's abilities enchant allied champions on-contact, causing their next basic attack or ability hit shortly after to apply a burst and then a short burn to the target enemy, both parts dealing magic damage.

facts.claim: He adds magic damage to allies' attacks and ability hits
with AP scaling on his burn and shields

cards.priority_reason: His protection and ally empowerment define how opponents should approach fights.

cards.answer: Fired Up! enchants champions touched by Milio's abilities, including himself. Their next attack or ability hit applies bonus magic damage followed by a short magic-damage burn.
cards.counterplay: Avoid casual trades with allies he has just empowered.

citations.quote: Milio's ability hits on himself and allied champions grant an enchantment for 4 seconds

facts.claim: Fired Up! enchants champions touched by Milio's abilities, including himself.

citations.quote: causing their next basic attack or ability hit shortly after to apply a burst and then a short burn to the target enemy, both parts dealing magic damage.

facts.claim: Their next attack or ability hit applies bonus magic damage followed by a short magic-damage burn.

cards.priority_reason: Explains the extra damage behind his allies' trades.

cards.answer: Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back and stuns the first enemy hit, then bounces and explodes for magic damage and an area slow. Hitting a non-champion causes a farther knockback and a larger explosion.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the ball and avoid standing behind minions in its path.

citations.quote: Milio kicks a fireball in the target direction that briefly knocks back and stuns the first enemy hit. The ball then bounces once toward the target and explodes, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies hit.

facts.claim: Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back and stuns the first enemy hit, then bounces and explodes for magic damage and an area slow.

citations.quote: If the primary target is a non-champion, the ball knocks back further and creates a larger explosion.

facts.claim: Hitting a non-champion causes a farther knockback and a larger explosion.

cards.priority_reason: His displacement can interrupt an approach, while minions can extend the explosion threat.

cards.answer: Cozy Campfire follows an allied champion, continually healing nearby allies and increasing their attack range. Milio can redirect it to another ally, and the range increase persists for the campfire's duration even after an ally leaves the zone.
cards.counterplay: Give empowered attackers extra space and avoid prolonged trades around the campfire.

citations.quote: Milio summons a fuemigo that lasts for 6 seconds and follows the closest allied champion. Allied champions near the fuemigo gain increased attack range and are continually healed.

facts.claim: Cozy Campfire follows an allied champion, continually healing nearby allies and increasing their attack range.

citations.quote: Recast: The fuemigo follows the target allied champion.

facts.claim: Milio can redirect it to another ally

citations.quote: The attack range increase lingers on allies for the entire duration of Cozy Campfire, even if they leave the zone.

facts.claim: the range increase persists for the campfire's duration even after an ally leaves the zone

cards.priority_reason: Extended attack range changes safe spacing even outside the healing zone.

cards.answer: Warm Hugs briefly shields Milio or an allied champion and increases their movement speed. It stores charges, allowing repeated casts whose shield and movement-speed effects can stack.
cards.counterplay: Account for a follow-up shield when chasing, and consider delaying damage until the protection fades.

citations.quote: Milio envelops himself or the target allied champion in protective flames, granting the target a shield and bonus movement speed for 2.5 seconds.

facts.claim: Warm Hugs briefly shields Milio or an allied champion and increases their movement speed.

citations.quote: Milio periodically stocks a Warm Hugs charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Warm Hugs' effects can stack up to 2 times.

facts.claim: It stores charges, allowing repeated casts whose shield and movement-speed effects can stack.

cards.priority_reason: Repeated protection and speed boosts affect burst attempts and chases.

cards.answer: Breath of Life heals Milio and nearby allied champions, removes non-airborne crowd control and briefly grants tenacity. Milio cannot cast it while affected by crowd control that prevents casting.
cards.counterplay: Consider disabling Milio before committing crowd control to nearby allies; account for his group heal.

citations.quote: Milio explodes in soothing flames, healing and cleansing himself and nearby allied champions of non- airborne crowd control and granting them tenacity for a short time.

facts.claim: Breath of Life heals Milio and nearby allied champions, removes non-airborne crowd control and briefly grants tenacity.

citations.quote: Breath of Life cannot be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.

facts.claim: Milio cannot cast it while affected by crowd control that prevents casting.

cards.priority_reason: The group cleanse can undermine crowd-control engages, and disabling Milio limits access to it.

cooldown_candidates.reason: Track availability of the group heal and cleanse before committing an engage.
Its downtime creates opportunities to approach without the knockback threat.
Campfire availability changes healing and attack-range pressure.
Track charge recharge rather than treating the brief cast interval as full recovery.
